艾琳是精灵族的年轻魔法师，天生能同时感受到火、水、风。长老总说她太急，一个元素还: Erin is a young elven mage who was born able to feel fire, water and wind all at once. The elders say she is too hasty, always mixing all three before she has mastered even one. She refuses to agree: the elements talk to each other, it's just that nobody listens. Hearing that the gate on the summit connects every world, she shouldered her staff and started climbing to see what the elements look like on the other side. Her spells work only half the time, and what she fears most isn't failing but hearing someone say "I told you so." Only later does she learn that the secret of combining isn't speed, but waiting for the right one.

エリンはエルフの若い魔法使いで、生まれつき火・水・風を同時に感じ取れる。長老たちはいつも、ひとつも極めないうちに三つを混ぜたがる彼女をせっかちだと言う。でも彼女は納得しない。元素はもともと語り合っている、ただ誰も耳を傾けないだけだ、と。山頂の門がすべての世界につながっていると聞き、杖を背負って山を登り始めた。門の向こうの元素がどんな姿なのか見てみたいのだ。道中、魔法は当たったり外れたり。一番怖いのは失敗ではなく、「だから言ったのに」の一言だった。やがて彼女は気づく。組み合わせのコツは速さではなく、正しい一つを待つことなのだと。
顾清寒是雪山剑派的弟子。门里为“先练气”还是“先练剑”吵成两派，她两边都偷学，结: Gu Qinghan is a disciple of the Snow Mountain Sword Sect. The sect split in two over whether to train qi first or the sword first; she secretly learned both, and neither side would claim her. When the demon lord took the summit, the sect was driven down the mountain and her seniors scattered. Only she walked back up, sword on her back. She is used to training alone and carrying everything alone, even channeling qi in secret at night to treat her wounds. Then one day a companion took a blow meant for her, and she realized: if one person can master two schools at once, a team can bind a handful of oddballs into one.

顧清寒は雪山剣派の弟子だ。門内は「先に気を練るか、先に剣を練るか」で二派に割れ、彼女は両方をこっそり学んだせいで、どちらにも認められなかった。魔王が山頂を奪い、剣派は山を追われ、兄弟子たちは散り散りになった。剣を背負って山へ引き返したのは彼女だけだった。一人で稽古し、一人で背負うのに慣れていて、傷を負っても夜にこっそり気を巡らせるだけ。ある日、仲間が彼女をかばって一太刀を受けた。その時やっと気づいた。一人が二つの剣法を同時に使えるのなら、一つの隊も変わり者たちを一本により合わせられるのだと。
希尔薇是远古白龙最后的后裔，平时是个话少、怕冷的安静少女。可只要情绪一激动，鳞片: Sylvie is the last descendant of an ancient white dragon: usually a quiet girl who says little and hates the cold. But whenever her emotions run high, scales sprout from the backs of her hands, and by the time she comes to, everything around her is frozen. She can't remember what she does as a dragon, so she has always kept her distance from people. When the demon lord seized her ancestors' nest, she had no choice but to come down the mountain. The first time she transformed in front of everyone, she was sure her companions would run. Instead, someone just draped a coat over her shoulders and said, "Cold, isn't it? Come back when you're ready."

シルヴィは古の白竜の最後の末裔で、普段は口数が少なく寒がりな静かな少女だ。けれど感情が高ぶると手の甲から鱗が生え、我に返ると辺り一面が凍りついている。竜になっている間のことは覚えていないから、ずっと人から距離を置いてきた。魔王が祖先の竜の巣を奪い、彼女は山を下りるしかなかった。初めて皆の前で変身した日、仲間は逃げ出すと思っていた。けれど誰かが黙って上着を肩にかけて言った。「寒いでしょ。戻ったらそれでいいよ。」
米娅是人类和猫耳族的混血，两边的族人都不太接纳她，从小只有云猫团子陪着。团子的母: Mia is half human and half catfolk. Neither side ever quite accepted her, and since childhood her only companion has been Dango, a cloud cat kitten. Dango's mother is the mountain's guardian spirit, and the goblins took her, so Mia scooped up Dango and headed up the mountain. She always says "I'm counting on you, nya," but every time Dango charges in, her tail goes stiff as a board. She thought she was the one protecting Dango, until the day Dango first stood in front of her, fur puffed up at a monster ten times its size. Dango wanted to protect her too.

ミアは人間と猫耳族のハーフで、どちらの一族にもあまり受け入れられず、幼い頃から雲猫の団子だけがそばにいた。団子の母は山の守り神で、ゴブリンにさらわれてしまった。ミアは団子を抱えて山へ向かった。口ではいつも「お願いにゃ」と言うけれど、団子が飛び出すたびに尻尾はぴんと張りつめている。自分が団子を守っているのだと思っていた。団子が初めて彼女の前に立ちはだかり、自分の十倍もある魔物に毛を逆立てた、あの日までは。団子も彼女を守りたかったのだ。
绯月是日本的高中生，那道光卷走的不止三个人。她一直不知道，母亲那边流着吸血鬼的血: Feiyue is a Japanese high school student; that light swept away more than three people. She never knew her mother's side carried vampire blood, until the blood moon rose over the castle and her eyes began to glow in the dark. The Count recognized her at once and told her this was her real home. She refused, but every time she uses that power, she drifts a little further from being human. What scares her most isn't the blood; it's the thought that one day her friends might look at her the way the Count does. In the end she found their eyes never changed: she was still the classmate who gives away the last sip of water.

On her way home with her bag full of mahjong tiles, she too was swept away by that light. In the other world the tiles in her bag began to glow, and forming hands unleashes magic. She is used to reading everything like a game: who will discard what, which road is safest, who can be trusted. But on this journey, someone always plays a tile she didn't see coming. Eventually she stopped calculating, and for the first time she bet her last tile on her friends.
